legal_reason: Government Code 11346.1(c)-(h), HSC 18937(b) and 18938(a) require filing and timely certification, separately from approval. The statute allows a later effective date and limits time in effect, so an expiry calculated from the May vote or original November filing alone would be unsound. General July 2027 supplement publication does not establish the emergency bridge.
